en: A black-and-white postcard image showing a dramatic landscape with a forested gorge, a curved arch bridge crossing over it, and a waterway with a vessel (possibly a steamboat) below. There is a tall industrial chimney in the background, and some buildings are visible near the water. The bridge appears to have pedestrian railings and streetlamps. The scene is framed by rocky cliffs and dense trees.
